select u.id,u.name,u.phone,u.sex,u.birth_year,u.height,u.hometown,u.current_city,u.education, u.occupation,u.monthly_income,u.family_members,u.hobbies,u.advantages, u.has_car,u.has_house,u.has_tattoo,u.smoke_habit,u.drink_habit,u.accept_long_dist, u.photos,u.status,u.service_status,u.del_flag,u.create_time, coalesce(s.nick_name,s.user_name,u.create_by) as matchmaker_name, dp.pair_id,dp.progress as pair_progress, case when then 1 else 0 end as service_eligible, case when then 1 else 0 end as source_eligible, case when then 1 else 0 end as reverse_matched, p.id as source_id,p.birth_year as source_birth_year,p.height as source_height, p.education as source_education,p.current_city as source_current_city,p.hometown as source_hometown, p.has_car as source_has_car,p.has_house as source_has_house,p.has_tattoo as source_has_tattoo, p.smoke_habit as source_smoke_habit,p.drink_habit as source_drink_habit, r.id as req_id,r.paying_id as req_paying_id,r.age_min as req_age_min,r.age_max as req_age_max, r.height_min as req_height_min,r.height_max as req_height_max,r.education as req_education, r.hometown_require as req_hometown_require,r.city_require as req_city_require, r.has_car as req_has_car,r.has_house as req_has_house,r.no_tattoo as req_no_tattoo, r.smoke_habit as req_smoke_habit,r.drink_habit as req_drink_habit, r.accept_long_dist as req_accept_long_dist,r.other_require as req_other_require from sys_paying_user u join sys_paying_user p on p.id=#{payingId} and p.id!=u.id and p.sex!=u.sex left join sys_user s on s.user_id=u.matchmaker_id left join sys_user ps on ps.user_id=p.matchmaker_id left join sys_paying_requirement r on r.paying_id=u.id and r.id=( select max(latest.id) from sys_paying_requirement latest where latest.paying_id=u.id) left join dating_pair dp on dp.user_low_id=least(u.id,p.id) and dp.user_high_id=greatest(u.id,p.id) where u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' and u.sex in ('0','1') and p.status='0' and p.del_flag='0' and p.sex in ('0','1')
and (case when p.matchmaker_id is null then p.create_by else ps.user_name end)=#{params.archiveOwner}
and ()
